Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent mascot cutout for a consumer fitness app prototype.
Primary request: An original small swift bird named Zip, running right with one pointed black wing swept back, red athletic headband, long thin legs and exaggerated red-and-white running sneakers. White chest, black tail, friendly confident eyes and little open beak smile. Dynamic comic motion strokes and very restrained halftone incorporated only into the character. Flat graphic novel illustration with confident dark ink, tomato red, warm white. Mature sports-comic charisma.
Composition: ONE complete character centered on a square canvas, full body and all shoes, comfortable transparent padding on every side. Face clearly visible, readable at 120 pixels. The character takes 80 percent of canvas height.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent background, clean alpha edges, no scenery, no ground plane, no opaque backdrop.
Constraints: Original design, no existing IP, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no extra characters. Active, energetic, welcoming; never intimidating or gate-keepy. Do not render a mascot sheet, do not add UI.
